assessment_type: Final primary-assistant self-assessment; not an independent reviewer grade
scope: This chat’s inspection, strengthening and validation of the supplied already-implemented Task B baseline; not a clean-start implementation benchmark
method: Six categories from the supplied Task A specification; equal weights chosen for this assessment because no fixed scoring weights were supplied

scale.5: Fully supported by available task-scope evidence

categories.name: Functional correctness
categories.rationale: Task A search and B1–B17 have implementation and test evidence, including active-course checks, duplicate prevention, all allowed and invalid transitions, filtering and audit history.

categories.name: Tests and validation
categories.rationale: 666 unit/integration tests, 4 live-host acceptance scenarios and 19 architecture checks pass; lint, typecheck and full API/docs build pass. Cache reuse and the initial sandbox failure are disclosed.

categories.name: Architecture and codebase alignment
categories.rationale: Existing Hono/factory composition preserved without dependencies or vendor edits. Lifecycle rules and concrete storage still reside in application-services rather than the existing domain/persistence packages.

categories.name: Security and guardrail compliance
categories.rationale: This run’s source delta stays within allowed paths; validation, immutable storage returns and safe error envelopes are tested. Authentication, production configuration, secrets and vendored code are unchanged. No independent security audit is claimed.

categories.name: Context/token/cost efficiency
categories.rationale: 33 primary model requests consumed 2,449,032 tokens; repeated context and broad filesystem discovery added avoidable overhead. Most input was cached, reducing the rate-based cost. No matched baseline supports a comparative efficiency claim.

categories.name: Developer workflow fit
categories.rationale: Reviewable source archive and patch, endpoint docs, reproducible command logs, source hash/revision and final-response-inclusive accounting are provided. Scope and sample-only persistence limitations are explicit.

recommendation: Candidate for Pilot for the sample workflow; improve domain separation and context efficiency before broader use.
limitations: Starting branch already contained the complete workflow; this run strengthened and validated it.
No comparative harness benchmark or dedicated security scan.
Process-local storage and caller-supplied reviewer identities retain the sample’s limitations.
